ios.desc:
Site Records makes daily construction reporting easier. Keep project progress, workforce, materials, site photos and reports organised in one place, from the site to the office.

TEAM MODE. BETTER TOGETHER.
Improve productivity, coordination and collaboration with shared project records. Prepare reports with your team, see who recorded the work and keep members aligned through cloud updates. Manage project membership and bring everyone together around the same site information.

YOUR PROJECT, AT A GLANCE
Review workforce, materials and photos by day, week or month. Follow activity progress and open the source reports behind each record. Organise multiple projects and switch between them as work moves forward.

COMPLETE DAILY REPORTS
Bring site notes, weather, workforce numbers, total hours, material quantities, activities and photographs together in one daily record. Keep a clear account of what happened on site and the resources used.

ACTIVITY PROGRESS & INSIGHTS
Record completed quantities against planned targets. Compare daily totals, cumulative progress and remaining work, with charts and links to source reports that help you understand how work is progressing.

WORKFORCE & MATERIALS
Track workers and total hours by trade. Review material quantities with their units and trace entries back to the daily reports they came from.

SITE PHOTOS, ORGANISED
Link site photos directly to activities and materials, and review their photo journals inside saved reports. Add annotations and tags to keep visual evidence in context. Review photographs by date and category, with photo and report filtering available on eligible premium plans.

REPORTS READY TO SHARE
Export records in PDF, Excel and Word formats, with site notes, resource details and photographs. Available formats and options depend on your plan. Share progress with clients, colleagues and stakeholders. Premium plans remove the watermark for a clean presentation.

START FREE. UPGRADE AS YOUR NEEDS GROW.
Start with the Free plan for Solo reporting or a shared Team project, within the included project and record limits.

Premium Solo adds more capacity for individual projects, up to 12 photos per Solo report, automatic weather for new reports, filtering and watermark-free PDF exports.

Premium Team includes Premium Solo benefits, expanded Team capacity, shared project records and cloud synchronisation, and the ability to upload Solo projects to the cloud.

quotes.text:
Site Records: The Ultimate Productivity App for Professionals

Enhance your project management and reporting capabilities with Site Records, the must-have app designed to streamline your workflow and boost productivity. With its comprehensive set of features, Site Records empowers professionals to efficiently manage multiple projects and generate detailed daily reports, providing you with the essential tools to stay organized and stay on top of your work.

Key Features:

1. Say goodbye to the hassle of juggling multiple projects. Site Records enables you to create and effortlessly track progress on various projects all in one place.

2. Generate Detailed Daily Reports: Simplify the process of creating daily reports with Site Records. Seamlessly capture and document all essential project information, including weather conditions, manpower types and mobilized resources, material types and installed quantities, photos, and notes. Stay organized and never miss a critical detail.

3. Annotate Photos with Comments and Sketches: Visualize your project’s progress by adding comments and sketches directly onto photos within the app. Highlight key areas, mark up changes, and communicate effectively with your team, ensuring everyone is on the same page.

4. Track Project Progress: Gain valuable insights into your project's progress using the manpower and materials charts provided by Site Records.
